instruction_bn: সঠিক Wh-শব্দ বা প্রশ্নটি বেছে নাও।

items.q: ___ is your name? (asking about a name)
items.rule_bn: নাম/বস্তু জানতে চাইলে 'What' দিয়ে প্রশ্ন হয়।

items.q: ___ do you live? (asking about a place)
___ are you late? (asking about a reason)
___ do you go to school? (asking about time)
___ is that boy? (asking about a person)
___ do you go to school? (asking about manner)
Make a question: 'He is a teacher.'
items.rule_bn: Yes/No প্রশ্নে auxiliary verb (Is) সামনে আসে: Is he a teacher?

items.q: Which is the correct Wh-question for the answer 'In Dhaka'?
